SELECT prd."id" as receiveDetailId, pr."id" as receiveId, qi."id" as qcId, por."id" as returnId, por.approve_status as approveStatus, pord."id" returnDetailId, pord.sku_id as skuId, pord.sku_no as skuNo, pord.replenish_qty as replenishQty, pord.return_qty as returnQty FROM po_receive_detail prd LEFT JOIN po_receive pr ON pr."id" = prd.main_id and pr.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN qc_info qi ON qi.source_id = pr."id" and qi.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN po_return por ON por.source_id = qi."id" and por.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN po_return_detail pord ON pord.main_id = por.ID and pord.is_deleted = FALSE
